content.short: OnRamp Money lets users buy, sell, and swap hundreds of cryptocurrencies across many countries and payment rails.
content.description: OnRamp Money is a fiat-crypto access service for buying, selling, and swapping digital assets. Its site describes support for hundreds of cryptocurrencies, many countries, local payment methods such as UPI, SEPA, and PIX, and business integration options. The TON relevance is onboarding and conversion, not a native TON protocol. Buy, sell & swap 480+ cryptocurrencies across 75+ countries with the lowest fees. Those details make how many cryptocurrencies do you support?, which fiat currencies does onramp provide support for?, can i subsidize fees charged to users?, and where does onramp part of the product story.money source liquidity from?.
